facts.fact: The Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act, 2024, passed by both Houses of the National Assembly, amends the Cybercrimes Act No. 17 of 2015, including cutting incident reporting from 7 days to 72 hours of detection.
facts.system: Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act, 2015, as amended 2024
